d: Internal garden in the palace of the king of Persia corresponding to several apartments. View of the palace, night with moon. Mandane and Arbace.
Arbace, then Artabano with bloody naked sword.
Artabano, then Artaxerxes and Megabise with Guards.
Megabise, then disarmed Arbey between the Guards and sayings.
Mandane, Semira, Arbace, Artabano, Megabise and Guards.
Arbace, Semira, Mandane and Megabise and Guards.
Arbace, Mandane and Megabise and Guards.
Artabano, then Arbace with some Guards.

Great room of the royal council with throne on one side, seats on the other for the Greats of the kingdom. Table and chair to the right of the said throne. Artaxerxes preceded by a part of the Guards and the Greats of the kingdom, followed by the remaining Guards, then Megabise.
Send it, Semira, Megabise and said.
Arbace, with chains between some Guards, and sayings.
Internal part of the fortress, in which Arbace is considered prison. Gates in perspective. Picciola carries by right hand, for which he ascends to the palace. Arbace, then Artaxerxes.
Artabano with followers of Conspirati, then Megabise, all give gates, to guard of which the Conspirates remain.
Cabinet in the apartments of Mandane. Mandane, then Semira.

Magnificent place intended for the crowning of Artaxerxes. Throne on one side with above scepter and crown. Ara in the middle lit with simulacrum of the sun. Artaxerxes and Artabano with numerous Séguito and People.
